title: Twin Heart Necklace
descriptionHtml:
Two hearts, one a little smaller. A larger and a smaller heart cut clear cubic zirconia sit side by side and touching, each in slim gold claws, with a fine gold tone cable chain fixed at the outer side of each heart so the pair stays centred at the base of the throat. Together they measure about 8.5mm across.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Twin Heart Studs, or alone with an open neckline.

Details

  • Pendant: Two hearts side by side, approximately 8.5mm across together
  • Stone: Heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5mm and 3.5mm
  • Setting: Slim gold claws
  • Chain: Fine cable chain, fixed at both sides of the hearts
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
